This assignment is in place of class on Monday, September 21, 2026.

Run this code and then practice creating new code chunks with additional graphs. First makes changes to `dbwt` graph, and then create graphs using other columns in the dataset.

```{r}
#| label: birthweight
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("nat2024samp.csv")
ggplot(df, aes(x = dbwt)) + 
  geom_histogram(fill = "cornflowerblue",
                 color = "blue",
                 boundary = 0,
                 binwidth = 250) +
  theme_minimal()
```
